sections.title: Sound of letter cu
paragraphs: The letter is named (cu) /ku/. Its main sound is heard in the word (queso) /ˈke.so/, which means cheese. The letter makes only one sound in Spanish words. It always joins with another letter to make this sound.

sections.title: How to say cu
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air completely for a moment. Then let the air burst out quickly. Keep your voice completely off. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake at all.

sections.title: Spelling of cu
paragraphs: This letter always appears right before the vowel u, followed by e or i. The letter makes the sound heard in (queso) /ˈke.so/. You hear this same sound before the letter i in (química) /ˈki.mi.ka/.

sections.title: Comparing cu with English
paragraphs: Do not pronounce the letter u after it like the w in quick. The following letter is completely silent. Do not let out a strong puff of air like the k in kid. Keep the burst of air very crisp and short.
